# Orange Slice

Orange Slice is the cheerful, adventurous earth pony tourist from Whinnyapolis who visits Canterlot with her companion Chargrill Breadwinner, generally identified as her husband. Remember her as the vacationer who actually wants spicy food while the fashionable restaurants serve bland dishes.

[![Orange Slice and Chargrill Breadwinner — Hasbro Studios, Friendship Is Magic, S6E12](https://camo.fimfiction.net/4tJJjacU1U5sYaSPPJv9QHD_EFCbLUAdD59ig2ipmcQ?url=https%3A%2F%2Fderpicdn.net%2Fimg%2Fview%2F2016%2F6%2F11%2F1175934__safe_clothes_screencap_shirt_discovery%2Bfamily%2Blogo_spoiler-colon-s06e12_spice%2Bup%2Byour%2Blife_watch_wristwatch_fanny%2Bpack.png)](https://www.fimfiction.net/blog/643540/spoilers-mariusioannesp-reviews-spice-up-your-life)

- Appearance: golden-yellow coat, curly coral-red mane and tail, brown eyes, purple-framed glasses, burgundy bow-like headwear, green blouse, spotted waist pouch and an orange-slice cutie mark.
- Name and voice: Orange Slice is her credited character name, not a fan invention; she speaks in her debut and is voiced by Enid-Raye Adams ([cast credits](https://watch.plex.tv/en-GB/show/my-little-pony-friendship-is-magic/credits)). No verified alternate identity.
- Appearances: *Spice Up Your Life* (S6E12, June 11, 2016; production order E13), followed by background appearances in *Viva Las Pegasus* (S6E20, [illustrated episode follow-up](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2016/09/viva-las-pegasus-episode-followup.html?variant=3181225977953)), *Once Upon a Zeppelin* (S7E22) and *Grannies Gone Wild* (S8E5), as catalogued in the [earth pony directory](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies/Mares). She is part of the official G4 television continuity; no additional speaking role was verified.

## Important moments

Both scenes are in [Spice Up Your Life (S6E12), official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PAAfddIfbRk); exact video timestamps unavailable. The [episode transcript](https://transcripts.foreverdreaming.org/viewtopic.php?p=188177) confirms the dialogue and sequence.

- **Giving an unrated restaurant a chance** — *Spice Up Your Life* (S6E12): Orange Slice and Chargrill become the only customers Pinkie and Saffron initially recruit, demonstrating that some visitors value originality more than prestige.
- **Asking for real flavor** — *Spice Up Your Life* (S6E12): She orders the special with extra kick, directly contrasting with Zesty Gourmand's insistence on barely perceptible flavors.

Research limits: The wiki directory and episode credits were available in indexed extracts, but direct wiki access was blocked. The embedded still was verified on its contextual review page; the original booru post was inaccessible. No separately attributed fan artwork or exact scene timestamps were verified.
